usedFor: Toodledo holds tasks and Notion holds pages, so “New Task Created” can run “Create Page” for each one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created” in Toodledo, then “Create Page” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Each Toodledo task gets a Notion page where you can add notes and context.

watchOut: “New Task Created” in Toodledo is polling, so the Notion page appears after a scheduled check.
